summary: Two critical standards breaks: the CAD material is 6061 where the blueprint commits to EN AW-6082-T6, and the M8 counterbore is 6 mm deep, so the ISO 4762 heads stand proud instead of flush. The fastener designation is also incomplete.

flags.title: CAD material 6061 Alloy disagrees with blueprint EN AW-6082-T6
flags.evidence: snapshot parts[0].material.name = '6061 Alloy' and drawings[0].title_block.material = '6061 Alloy'. Blueprint front-matter material = EN AW-6082-T6, and the §7 hand calc uses Rp0.2 = 250 MPa for 6082-T6. The material is not named per EN.
flags.recommendation: Assign EN AW-6082-T6 in CAD (custom material if the library lacks it) and refresh the title block. Mass and the SF calc then refer to the stated alloy.

flags.title: Counterbore too shallow: ISO 4762 M8 heads stand proud, flush required
flags.evidence: snapshot holes[0].counterbore = Ø15.0 x 6.0 deep (4 holes, 80 x 40 pattern). DIN 974-1 M8 counterbore = Ø15 x 8.6 (head height 8 + 0.6, no washer). Head is about 2 mm proud with 6 mm depth. CON-002 requires heads flush (hard). Base thickness is 10 mm (PAR-001), so an 8.6 mm depth leaves only 1.4 mm of floor under the 8.4 through-hole.
flags.recommendation: Deepen the counterbore to 8.6 mm per DIN 974-1 (diameter 15 is correct). Then check that the 1.4 mm floor is acceptable, or increase the base thickness or use a low-head screw. That choice affects §7 and CON-001, so decide it explicitly.

suggested_change.detail: Set counterbore depth to 8.6 and re-check the floor and bending (thickness PAR-001), or change the fastener and head type

flags.title: Fastener not fully designated
flags.evidence: Blueprint CON-002 reads '4x ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8, heads flush'. It has no length or property class, e.g. ISO 4762 M8x25-8.8. The grip length depends on the 10 mm base thickness and the counterbore depth. Drawing hole callout RD3 shows only Ø8.4 and Ø15 x 6.
flags.recommendation: Add the full designation (for example ISO 4762 M8x25-8.8, or 12.9 if specified) to CON-002 or §6 and to the BOM or drawing note. Drop the DIN 912 duplicate, or keep it only as a cross-reference.

suggested_change.detail: CON-002: ISO 4762 M8x<L>-<class>, with L chosen from the wall plate stack

flags.title: Interface and pin-hole dimensions carry no tolerance or fit
flags.evidence: snapshot parts[0].dimensions: D1@Pin hole (Ø3), D2@Pin hole (36) and the INT-001 80 x 40 pattern positions all have tolerance = null. Blueprint §6 gives only ISO 2768-mK and names no ISO 286 fit. The Ø3 pin hole implies a pin fit, but the mating part is not defined. The Ø8.4 hole sits within ISO 273 fine series (M8 = 8.4), so the clearance size is OK.
flags.recommendation: If the Ø3 hole receives a dowel or pin, state the fit in §6 (for example H7) and the tolerance on D1@Pin hole. Consider a positional tolerance for the 80 x 40 pattern against datum A if the wall plate is tight. Otherwise ISO 2768-mK covers these.

suggested_change.detail: Add the pin fit (for example Ø3 H7) and the INT-001 hole-pattern position tolerance to §6 if they matter
